<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple services (model services@1): the heading, a description and the services as a list, each with the
  name (a link when the service has an address), a line and the price as it is shown (from 90 000 per project).
  Text only. Axes: layout (cards: a card surface per service; rows: one row per service, the price at the end
  from md up), cols (3, 2 columns of the cards).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Service } from "./services-simple.types";

export type ServicesSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  items: Service[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "cards" | "rows";
  cols?: "3" | "2";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  items,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "cards",
  cols = "3",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ServicesSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const grid = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "mx-auto max-w-3xl grid-cols-1 gap-4"
  : (cols as string) === "2" ? "grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"
  : "grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
);
const item = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "rounded border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-4 md:grid-cols-3"
  : "rounded border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground flex flex-col gap-4"
);
const copy = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "rows") ? "md:col-span-2" : "grow");
const cost = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "text-start md:text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="services-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid', grid))">
          <ListItem v-for="s in items" :key="s.id" :class="item" data-slot="service">
            <Stack gap="2" align="start" :class="copy">
              <LinkPlain v-if="s.href" :href="urlOf(s.href)" class="hover:text-primary">
                <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                  {{ s.title }}
                </Title>
              </LinkPlain>
              <Title v-else :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                {{ s.title }}
              </Title>
              <Text v-if="s.description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', 'text-start')">
                {{ s.description }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Text v-if="s.price" size="base" weight="semibold" :class="cn('text-primary', cost)">
              {{ s.price }}
            </Text>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
